notes: Ambient title, D aeolian 3/4 at 66. bell_tower = Analog Lab Sustained Bells built +12, so it rings at the written pitch class an octave up (D4-A4): at the written octave its partials sit 8 c sharp with the left channel 9 c under the right (title v9 gate), so it stays at the in-tune octave and gets its distance from a 1.8 kHz low-pass and a lower level instead; harp = Analog Harp; strings_low = 12 Low Strings (+12, the preset sounds an octave low); choir_pad = Simple Ohh; flute = Meadow Flute; sub_breath = Simple Sine (Clean) (Synclavier V) with Amp Env Offset attack and release at 1.0, so each 4-bar note breathes in over ~11 s and out over ~6 s (v1/v2 held a flat sine that stopped dead). Presets gated with gate_stems. Strings breathe by voices (2 to 5) on the 8-bar cycle; the sub doubles itself an octave up so the breath carries on small speakers.
